title: vehicle-sil coordinated virtual-time benchmark report, format 1
description: Machine-readable report produced by scripts/benchmark-vtime.py. Records repository/build/dependency provenance, fixed virtual workload, explicit steady-state measurement boundaries, per-iteration wall-clock/CPU/Control-transport telemetry, deterministic output and CAN communication trace verification digests, summary statistics, and anti-misinterpretation contracts.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to schema/benchmark-report.schema.json for editor validation.

generated_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the report was generated.

execution_backend.description: Execution backend measured by this suite. Always silkit_coordinated_multiprocess.

interpretation_contract.description: Anti-misinterpretation invariants that readers and downstream tools must respect.

local_bench_substitutable.description: Always false: LocalBench or in-process microbenchmarks cannot substitute for SIL Kit coordinated sync.

process_count_equals_participant_count_a.description: Always false: ecu_count, silkit_participant_count, and os_process_count are distinct quantities.

wall_cpu_handler_summable.description: Always false: steady_state wall time, process CPU time, and Control handler_time_ns must never be summed.

notes.description: Human-readable anti-misinterpretation rules including trivial CAN vs NetworkSimulator distinction.

provenance.description: Repository, build flags, dependency, and host provenance.

repo.description: Git revision and launcher version provenance.

git_commit.description: 40-character Git commit SHA, or null outside a Git checkout.

git_dirty.description: True if the working tree has uncommitted changes, or null outside a Git checkout.

launcher_features.description: Sorted list of feature tokens reported by vehicle_sil_launch version --json.

build.description: Actual compiler and optimization flags extracted from build metadata (never assumed from preset name).

build_dir.description: Build directory inspected for compile_commands.json / CMakeCache.txt, or null.

cmake_build_type.description: CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE from CMakeCache.txt, or null if unavailable.

flags_source.description: Provenance source for compiler and optimization flags.

flags_warning.description: Non-null warning when actual flags conflict with CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE or disagree across targets.

targets.description: Per-target compiler and flag facts for representative translation units.

ndebug.description: Whether NDEBUG was defined at compile time.

bench_ecu_build_info.description: Compile-time defines reported by vehicle_sil_bench_ecu --bench-build-info, or null.

dependencies.description: SIL Kit and optional dependency provenance.

sil_kit.description: SIL Kit submodule, tag, patch, and linkage provenance.

submodule_commit.description: Commit SHA of external/sil-kit, or null.

tag.description: Exact Git tag of external/sil-kit, or null.

patches.description: Patches under patches/sil-kit/ with SHA-256 hashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of patch file.

control_server_built.description: True if control-server is present in launcher_features.

host.description: Host platform and CPU environment metadata.

cpu_model.description: CPU model string, or null if unavailable.

run_options.description: Runner configuration for this benchmark invocation.

warmup_iterations.description: Number of full warm-up iterations executed and excluded from summary statistics.

measured_iterations.description: Number of measured iterations aggregated into summary statistics.

cases.description: Executed benchmark cases and their per-iteration and summary results.

unavailable_target_build_flags.description: Enforces null optimization/codegen/sanitizer/ndebug fields when flags_source == unavailable.

target_build_flags.description: Compiler and effective flag facts for one target translation unit.

compiler_id.description: Compiler ID (e.g. GNU, Clang, MSVC), or null.

optimization_flags.description: All -O* / /O* flags in command-line order, or null when unavailable.

effective_opt_level.description: Last optimization flag (last-flag-wins), or null if none / unavailable.

codegen_and_defines.description: Relevant codegen/define flags (-DNDEBUG, -flto*, -march=*, -g*, etc.), or null when unavailable.

sanitizers.description: Active -fsanitize=* flags, or null when unavailable.

ndebug.description: Whether -DNDEBUG is active in compile flags, or null.

iqr.description: Interquartile range (Q3 - Q1) across measured iterations.

optional_cpu_summary.description: Summary CPU statistics across measured iterations, or explicit unavailable state with null values.

status.description: available if all measured iterations collected CPU; otherwise unavailable.

median.description: Median CPU ms, or null when unavailable.

min.description: Minimum CPU ms, or null when unavailable.

max.description: Maximum CPU ms, or null when unavailable.

per_ecu_cpu.description: Steady-state self-CPU delta for one ECU process.

reason.description: Reason when unavailable; null when available.

user_ms.description: User CPU time in ms, or null.

sys_ms.description: System/kernel CPU time in ms, or null.

total_ms.description: Total CPU time (user + sys) in ms, or null.

control_transport_metrics_iteration.description: Optional Issue 1 Control transport metrics from vehicle_sil_launch run --control-metrics.

status.description: Collection state for Issue 1 Control transport metrics.

unavailable_reason.description: Reason why Control transport metrics are unavailable, or null.

source.description: Source provenance from Issue 1 report, or null.

handler_time_ns.description: Cumulative controller receive-handler time in ns.

max_handler_time_ns.description: Maximum single receive-handler call time in ns.

counters.description: HubTransport::stats() counters when status == available; null otherwise.

iteration_record.description: Single benchmark iteration (either warmup or measured).

phase.description: Whether this iteration is warm-up or measured.

steady_state.description: Steady-state measurements strictly over [W, W + M).

window_skew_ns.description: Cross-ECU boundary skew: (max t_start - min t_start) + (max t_end - min t_end).

ecu_window_steps_total.description: Sum of ECU steps executed in [W, W + M).

ecu_window_steps_by_participant.description: Steps executed in [W, W + M) per ECU participant.

tx_in_window.description: CAN TX frames in [W, W + M).

rx_in_window.description: CAN RX frames whose tx_ms is in [W, W + M) (arriving in (W, W + M]).

tx_total.description: Total CAN TX frames in [0, W + M).

rx_total.description: Total CAN RX frames in {tx_ms < W + M, rx_ms <= W + M}.

non_steady_state.description: Quarantined non-steady-state telemetry (setup, warm-up, tail, shutdown).

total_process_wall_ms.description: Outer monotonic wall time from vehicle_sil_launch spawn to exit.

paused_ms.description: Paused hold duration in ms (always verified 0).

reason.description: Reason when unavailable; null when available.

window_sim_ms.description: [W, W + M] virtual-time bounds in ms.

target_processes.description: ECU processes included in this CPU sum.

user_ms.description: Sum of ECU user CPU ms, or null.

sys_ms.description: Sum of ECU system CPU ms, or null.

total_ms.description: Sum of ECU total CPU ms, or null.

status.description: Availability of launcher process-tree CPU via os.wait4.

reason.description: Reason when unavailable; null when available.

interval.description: Full process lifetime from spawn to reap.

includes_non_steady_state.description: Always true: includes setup, --describe, warm-up, tail, and shutdown.

user_ms.description: Cumulative user CPU ms, or null.

sys_ms.description: Cumulative system CPU ms, or null.

total_ms.description: Cumulative total CPU ms, or null.

max_rss_kb.description: Maximum resident set size in KiB, or null.

determinism.description: Deterministic state and timestamped communication trace verification results.

verified.description: True when all deterministic and causal trace invariants passed.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 over canonical sorted ECU state digests and window step counts.

comm_trace_sha256.description: SHA-256 over canonical sorted TX/RX trace events in {tx_ms < W + M, rx_ms <= W + M}.

comm_events_verified.description: Total TX + RX events verified in {tx_ms < W + M, rx_ms <= W + M}.

environment_noise.description: Host contention observations around this iteration.

waited_s.description: Seconds spent waiting for busy_machine processes before starting.

others_before.description: Busy processes observed right before iteration launch.

others_after.description: Busy processes observed right after iteration exit.

load1_before.description: 1-minute OS load average before launch, or null on Windows.

load1_after.description: 1-minute OS load average after exit, or null on Windows.

benchmark_case.description: One benchmark case definition, its warm-up and measured iterations, and aggregated summary.

topology.description: Explicitly separated ECU, SIL Kit participant, and OS process counts.

silkit_participant_count.description: Total coordinated SIL Kit participants (includes SimulationController).

silkit_registry_hosted_in.description: Process hosting the SIL Kit registry.

ecus.description: Per-ECU step, sampling, and CAN configuration.

step_ms.description: ECU virtual-time step width in ms.

effective_sample_period_ms.description: Actual effective Control sample period in ms (reflecting --sample-every-step).

can_period_ms.description: Cyclic CAN TX period in ms (0 if disabled).

can_offset_ms.description: CAN TX phase offset in ms.

workload.description: Fixed virtual workload parameters for this case.

time_step_ms_configured.description: Configured time_step_ms, or null when auto-derived via GCD.

time_step_ms_resolved.description: Resolved controller time_step_ms reported by launcher.

warmup_sim_ms.description: In-run warm-up virtual duration W in ms.

measure_sim_ms.description: Measured steady-state virtual duration M in ms.

tail_sim_ms.description: Post-window tail cushion in ms (>= max ECU step_ms).

wire_vars_per_ecu.description: Total wire schema variables per ECU (declared + 4 built-in Peer/ECU variables).

step_work.description: Extra deterministic integer mixing iterations per step.

scenario.description: Scenario identifier if enabled, or null.

can_simulation_mode.description: CAN simulation mode. Canonical suite measures SIL Kit built-in trivial CAN broadcast only.

network_simulator.description: Always null for canonical trivial-CAN runs (no vehicle_sil_can_bus_simulator / sil-kit-net-sim participant).

can_tx_frames_per_sim_s.description: Aggregate CAN TX frames per virtual second.

can_rx_frames_per_sim_s.description: Aggregate CAN RX frames per virtual second.

control_samples_per_sim_s.description: Aggregate Control sample frames per virtual second.

measurement_boundaries.description: Explicit steady-state window and excluded phases.

steady_state_window_sim_ms.description: [W, W + M] virtual-time bounds in ms.

excluded_from_steady_state.description: Phases explicitly excluded from steady_state metrics.

warmup_iterations.description: Warm-up iterations strictly excluded from summary statistics.

iterations.description: Measured iterations aggregated into summary statistics.

summary.description: Aggregated statistics across measured iterations only.

status.description: Summary status for Control transport metrics.

all_iterations_identical.description: True when every warm-up and measured iteration matched bit-for-bit.

output_sha256.description: Shared output digest across all iterations.

comm_trace_sha256.description: Shared causal CAN trace digest across all iterations.
